newsitem.title: USA: Linens 'n Things sales surge, plans 20-25 superstores.
newsitem.headline: Linens 'n Things sales surge, plans 20-25 superstores.

text.p: Linens 'n Things Inc., a retailer of home textiles, housewares and home accessories, Tuesday reported a surge in fourth-quarter sales and said it expects to open 20 to 25 superstores in 1997.
The company, which went public in late November, said its revenues surged 29.6 percent to $230 million in the fourth quarter from $177.5 million for the same period last year.
Total comparable store sales increased 5.0 percent for the quarter, while comparative store sales for the company's superstores grew 7.2 percent, it said.
Linens 'n Things, based in Clifton, N.J., said the expansion of its superstore concept remains on track.
Superstores average about 35,000 square feet, compared with traditional stores that average about 7,000-10,000 square feet, it said.
Linens 'n Things opened 36 superstores in 1996 and currently operates 169 stores in 34 states.
Its stock rose 25 cents to $17.875 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
